Wetherby Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Intuitive Surgical Inc (ISRG) by 227.45% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 1,336 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $488,000, up from 408 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wetherby Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Intuitive Surgical Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $53.08 billion market cap company.
